coverageNotes: Tests one shallow patch operation. Missing-document checking and argument validation are supplied as shared setup; concurrency, authorization and creation are not measured. Static rejection and runtime rejection are recorded separately for B and C.

questions.concept: Shallow document patch and replacing a nested object
questions.question: Which update replaces the author exactly, including removing an omitted phone, while preserving title, tags, and content?

options.rationale: Convex patch replaces supplied top-level fields. Rebuilding metadata preserves its siblings while replacing author, and content stays untouched.
Assumes a recursive merge. The supplied metadata replaces the old object and lacks required title and tags; TypeScript and schema validation reject it.
Assumes Mongo-style dotted update paths. Convex patch treats keys as top-level fields; metadata.author is not a declared document field.
Explicitly merging the old contact keeps its optional phone when the replacement omits phone, violating complete replacement.
